reference: R. Krishnan, S.P. Garg, N. Krishnamurthy, and E. Paul, Phase Diagrams of Binary Tantalum Alloys, S.P. Garg, M. Venkatraman, N. Krishnamurthy, and R. Krishnan, ed., Indian Institute of Metals, Calcutta, India, 118-120(1996); compiled in H. Okamoto, Desk Handbook: Phase Diagrams for Binary Alloys, 2nd ed., ASM International, Materials Park, OH (2010), p. 673
comment: evidence_class=assessed_phase_diagram (expert-drawn diagram, not experimental, not CALPHAD); ORCHID assessed-phase-assemblages v1.0.0, diagram NB-TA-p673; one point per phase field (centroid or pole of inaccessibility); single-phase: the phase at the point composition; two-phase: phases present, compositions unknown (null) with __HYPERPLANE__ at the point's overall composition. Variant with tie-lines: two-phase points with a tie_line block carry its endpoint compositions (isotherm through the point intersected with the drawn boundaries); caveat: drawing-based; boundary positions in assessed diagrams carry low credence -- use as weak/soft constraints.

orchid_uncertainty_budget.sigma_rule: max(sqrt(max(printed, reading, method)^2 + composition^2 + conversion^2), scatter); boundary margin reported, not combined
